sub: Presentation, collaboration and hybrid learning systems for K–12 and higher education. One partner designs, installs and supports it all.
intro_h: Built for How Students Learn Today
intro_p: Classrooms are no longer just a platform for presentation. They have become interactive, immersive and collaborative, and hybrid learning is now a necessity. Students expect a similar experience on campus or at home, and teachers expect them to actively participate either way.
tech_p: From a single display to a fully collaborative hybrid classroom, we design a system around your teaching goals.

cards.alt: University classroom with a large projection screen
cards.p: Large format displays, video walls, projection or direct view LED that capture attention and let teachers present from any device.
b: Present from laptops and mobile devices
Options weighed for your space and budget

cards.alt: Teacher presenting on a classroom display
cards.p: Immersive systems where students manipulate digital content, share from their own devices and present multiple sources at once.
b: Student response systems with real-time feedback

cards.p: Systems that let remote students participate from any location, so learning feels the same on campus or at home.
b: Existing rooms converted for distance learning

partner_p: One team designs, engineers, installs and supports your learning spaces, from a single classroom to a campus-wide rollout. You get one point of contact and one accountable partner.
gal_p: Example system designs, from small classrooms to auditoriums.
band_p: Schools, colleges and universities can purchase through our State of Utah cooperative contract, with prices guaranteed for the life of the contract. We also serve out-of-state education and government customers.
cta_h: Let's Talk About Your Learning Spaces
